Saturn in Pisces can indicate a sense of responsibility or duty, so try to stay organized and on top of things.
Dhanu (Sagittarius).study: With Mercury in Gemini, your communication skills are likely to be sharp, and you might find yourself learning new things or communicating effectively with others. However, the Sun in Cancer can make you more emotional, so try to stay objective when it comes to intellectual pursuits.

Dhanu (Sagittarius).travel: The current transits don't suggest any major travel plans or opportunities, but you might be feeling a sense of restlessness or wanderlust. With Rahu in Aquarius, you might be drawn to unconventional or adventurous travel options.
